question: How many athletes were honoured with the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award on January 17, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **January 17, 2025**, the President of India, **Droupadi Murmu**, conferred the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** for the year **2024** to **four** distinguished athletes at a specially organized ceremony at **Rashtrapati Bhavan**.
 
• The four recipients of India’s highest sporting honor are **Neeraj Chopra** (Athletics), **Manu Bhaker** (Shooting), **Harmanpreet Singh** (Hockey), and **P.R. Sreejesh** (Hockey).
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** was recognized for his consistent excellence, including winning the **silver medal** in the men's javelin throw at the **Paris 2024 Olympics**.
 
• **Manu Bhaker** created history by becoming the **first Indian athlete** in the post-independence era to win **two medals** (both bronze) in a single edition of the Olympics at **Paris 2024**.
 
• **Harmanpreet Singh**, the captain of the Indian men's hockey team, and legendary goalkeeper **P.R. Sreejesh** were honored for their instrumental roles in helping India secure a **consecutive bronze medal** at the **Olympic Games**.
 
• The awards, which are usually announced in December, were presented in **January 2025** to celebrate the exceptional achievements of Indian sportspersons on the global stage during the previous calendar year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award:**

 
 
• This is the **highest sporting honor** in the Republic of India, awarded annually by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**.
 
• The award was formerly known as the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award** until it was renamed in **August 2021** in honor of the hockey wizard **Major Dhyan Chand**.
 
• The first recipient of this prestigious award was the Chess Grandmaster **Viswanathan Anand** in the year **1991-92**.
 
• Recipients receive a **medallion**, a **certificate**, and a cash prize of **Rs. 25 lakh**.
 
 
 
• **Selection Process:**
 
 
• The awardees are selected by a committee constituted by the **Ministry**, which typically consists of a retired **Supreme Court or High Court Judge**, eminent sportspersons, and sports administrators.
 
• The performance of the athletes over a period of **four years** at the international level is taken into consideration for the selection.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other National Sports Awards:**

 
 
• Along with the Khel Ratna, the **Arjuna Award** is given for consistent outstanding performance over four years; the 2024 cycle saw several athletes honored for their **Paris 2024** performances.
 
• The **Dronacharya Award** is presented to coaches for producing medal winners at prestigious international events.
 
• The **Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime Achievement** honors those who have contributed to sports through their performance and continue to contribute to the promotion of sports after retirement.
 
 
 
• **Significance of 2024 Awards:**
 
 
• The **2024 awards** were highly anticipated due to India's performance at the **Paris Olympics** and **Paralympics**.
 
• **P.R. Sreejesh** received the award following his retirement from professional hockey after the **Paris 2024** bronze medal win, marking a fitting tribute to his **two-decade-long** career.
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** became one of the few athletes to be considered for the honor twice (having previously won), though the 2024 recognition solidified his status as India's greatest track and field athlete.
